course_outline_concepts: CommonCrawl / Wikipedia / The Pile / RedPajama / SlimPajama — what each is, what each omits
The 22-domain Pile composition and which subsets have aged well
2023 → 2026 shift: from raw-web maximalism to web+code+synthetic mix; why frontier labs stopped disclosing the mix
Licence and governance: copyright, opt-out registers, the enterprise-data constraint
Open vs closed pretraining data: what Dolma + FineWeb disclose that Llama 3 / Qwen don't

sources.what_to_extract: 22-subset composition, EleutherAI mixture-design argument, how specific domains (arXiv, PubMed, StackExchange, GitHub, Books3) aged, why diversity is a scaling variable.
15T token count from 96 Common Crawl dumps, Trafilatura extraction, per-dump MinHash (not global) finding, FineWeb-Edu 1.3T classifier-filtered subset, 450K Llama-3-70B annotations at threshold 3.

3T tokens, six-stage cascade (URL → doc dedup → lang → quality → content → paragraph dedup), per-source sub-pipelines (peS2o, The Stack, Reddit), the 'reproducibility as scientific contribution' framing.
T5 heuristic web-cleaning recipe; bad-word blocklist; language-only filter; the baseline against which every later open pipeline is measured.
fastText language ID + dedup + Wikipedia-perplexity quality scoring; the three-stage skeleton that FineWeb/Dolma still follow; multilingual coverage.
15.6T pretraining tokens, post-training-driven capability rise, the non-disclosure signature — no data mix percentages published; the canonical closed-but-detailed report.
OLMo-Mix-1124 composition (DCLM + Dolma 1.7 + Starcoder + Proof Pile II), 3.9T Stage 1 + 50B Dolmino cooldown; the most-disclosed open mix of 2025.
Dolma 3 (9.3T source tokens) / Dolma 3 Mix (~5.9T) / Dolmino (100B) / Longmino (50B) curriculum; the 'data curriculum disclosed at stage granularity' shift.
36T tokens across 119 languages; Qwen2.5-VL OCR-expanded PDF corpus, Qwen2.5-Math / Qwen2.5-Coder synthetic data; the 'pretraining mix is partly our own model's output' pattern.
The 2026 frontier-lab non-disclosure: 397B-A17B MoE released without a matching technical report; data-mix information absent entirely.
14.8T pretraining tokens, no mix disclosure, the 'infrastructure headline + opaque data' pattern; contrast with OLMo 3's stage-by-stage transparency.
Data quality as an explicit scaling variable; effective sample size framework; two corpora with same token count can lie on different loss curves.

track_role: Opening chapter of the data track. Establishes the landscape and vocabulary (corpora, licences, open vs closed disclosure) that ch-10..ch-17 operate on top of. Ch-10 drills into pipelines; ch-11 into tokenizers/shards/lineage; later chapters into specialization, domain-balance, and the lab.
